record.dic_text:
07894 Shiysah' {shee-shaw'}

與 07893 同源; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Shisha 1; 1

示沙 = "耶和華抗辯"
1) 所羅門王時王室的書記以利何烈和亞希亞的父親  （#王上 4:3|）
   1a) 顯然與 沙威沙 [7798] 同, 他在大衛王時擔任同樣的職務
record.edic_text:
07894 Shiysah' {shee-shaw'}

from the same as 07893;; n pr m

AV - Shisha 1; 1

Shisha = "Jehovah contends"
1) father of Elihoreph and Ahiah, the royal secretaries in the reign
   of Solomon
   1a) apparently the same as 'Shavsha' who held the same position
       under David
